title: BEVerse: Unified Perception and Prediction in Birds-Eye-View for Vision-Centric Autonomous Driving
text: One shared BEV with ego-motion-aligned temporal fusion; detection, semantic map and motion decoders hang on it and a grid sampler gives each task its own range and cell size (nuScenes val: Tiny mAP 32.1 / NDS 46.6 / map IoU 48.7, Small 35.2 / 49.5 / 51.7). Template for a coarse detection grid next to a fine lane grid on one trunk. Blockers: Swin backbone and temporal stack are heavy, no loss-weighting recipe read, no FPS. Use the head layout only.

title: PETRv2: A Unified Framework for 3D Perception from Multi-Camera Images
text: Task-specific queries (detection, BEV segmentation, 3D lane) read one shared set of image tokens with temporal 3D position embeddings; state of the art claimed on all three, no numbers on the page read. Shows a trunk can be shared without a shared dense head. Blockers: multi-camera transformer, query heads, not a dense 0.5 m grid. Context only.

title: Cross-view Transformers for real-time Map-view Semantic Segmentation
text: Pretrained EfficientNet-B4 features (1/8 and 1/16) plus camera-aware cross-view attention onto a 200 x 200 map for 100 m x 100 m (0.5 m cells); about 4x faster than prior work, 45 FPS demo, MIT licence. A cheap camera-to-BEV baseline with a pretrained image backbone at exactly our grid. Blockers: vehicle and road classes only, coarse features hurt thin lane markings, no boxes. Use as the fast camera path to try first.

title: GradNorm: Gradient Normalization for Adaptive Loss Balancing in Deep Multitask Networks
text: Learns one loss weight per task so that each task's gradient norm at the last shared layer follows a common target scaled by its relative training rate; one hyper-parameter alpha; claims parity with grid search (rule from memory). Our shared layer would be the BEV feature map; cost is one extra backward per task through it. Blockers: dense thin-lane losses and sparse heatmap losses differ in scale by orders, no BEV result. Use as the second choice after uncertainty weighting.

title: Multi-Task Learning Using Uncertainty to Weigh Losses for Scene Geometry and Semantics
text: A learned noise parameter per task weighs the losses (about 1/(2 sigma^2) times the loss plus log sigma; form from memory); the joint depth plus segmentation model beats separate models. Zero-cost default for a lane segmentation head plus a heatmap detection head. Blockers: focal and Dice losses are not likelihoods, tends to down-weight the hard thin-structure task, so clamp the log-variance. Use first.

title: Center-based 3D Object Detection and Tracking (CenterPoint)
text: Objects are BEV centre peaks of a class heatmap; sub-cell offset, size, rotation and velocity are regressed at the peak, tracking by greedy closest-point matching on velocity (nuScenes lidar 65.5 NDS, 63.8 AMOTA). Sensor-independent anchor-free head on any 0.5 m BEV map and the detection head of BEVFusion and CRN; radar Doppler could supply velocity. Blockers: Gaussian radius for small objects at 0.5 m cells, no camera numbers. Use as the detection head.

title: CenterFusion: Center-based Radar and Camera Fusion for 3D Object Detection
text: CenterNet-style image detector with a frustum association of radar returns to object centres; radar features refine depth, rotation and velocity (NDS over the camera baseline by more than 12 percent; velocity improves without temporal input). The single-camera plus radar baseline for detection. Blockers: image-plane, rule-based association, old backbone. Context only.

title: Revisiting Birds Eye View Perception Models with Frozen Foundation Models: DINOv2 and Metric3Dv2
text: Frozen DINOv2 features in Lift-Splat-Shoot give +7.4 vehicle IoU on nuScenes with half the data and iterations; Metric3Dv2 depth as pseudo-lidar in Simple-BEV gives +3 IoU. Evidence that a frozen DINOv2 (small) front end transfers to BEV and saves trainable parameters. Blockers: workshop paper, no absolute IoU or latency on the page, patch stride 14 is coarse for thin lanes, Metric3Dv2 is heavy. Use as the case for a frozen ViT-S front end.

title: RepVGG: Making VGG-style ConvNets Great Again
text: Multi-branch training block re-parameterised to a plain 3x3 conv stack for inference; over 80 percent ImageNet top-1, 83 percent faster than ResNet-50 on a 1080Ti. Candidate for a conv-only BEV encoder or head that fuses to plain 3x3 layers. Blockers: no BEV or segmentation result, speed measured on an old GPU. Watch.

title: Fast-BEV: A Fast and Strong Bird's-Eye View Perception Baseline
text: Fixed-geometry voxel lift (pre-computed index, no depth head, no transformer), multi-scale image encoder, light BEV encoder, image plus BEV augmentation; R50 gives 52.6 FPS and 47.3 NDS on a 2080Ti against BEVDepth-R50 41.3 FPS and 47.5 NDS. Speed template for a one-camera system at fixed calibration. Blockers: detection only in the abstract, far range and thin structures blur without depth. Use the lift and the augmentation list.

title: FCOS3D: Fully Convolutional One-Stage Monocular 3D Object Detection
text: Per-pixel 3D targets (centre offset, depth, size, rotation), FPN-level assignment by 2D size and Gaussian centre-ness on the projected 3D centre; top camera entry of the NeurIPS 2020 nuScenes challenge. Monocular pretraining or auxiliary head recipe for the image features. Blockers: heavy ResNet-101 + DCN config, nuScenes numbers not read. Context only.

title: Multi-Task Learning as a Bargaining Game (Nash-MTL)
text: Per-task gradients at the shared parameters are combined by the Nash bargaining solution, with a convergence guarantee; claims state of the art on MTL benchmarks. Fallback if weighting fails to keep the lane head alive next to detection. Blockers: one backward per task, small gains in later benchmarks (memory). Watch.

title: MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for Monocular 3D Object Detection
text: Foreground depth map plus depth encoder and a depth-guided decoder over learnable object queries; state of the art on KITTI. Only the auxiliary foreground-depth supervision transfers. Blockers: Hungarian matching, KITTI only. Context only.
